hero.title: Pricing built around your organization
hero.subtitle: Zylo Office is activated module by module, station by station: the price depends on the modules you choose (Zylo Liquid, Zylo Tanker), the number of sites, and your organization's setup. We work out a quote with you instead of displaying a standard rate that would not fit anyone.

tiers.sectionSubtitle: These plans illustrate the most common module combinations. Every organization is still free to activate or deactivate modules based on its own needs.
tiers.priceNote: Priced according to your modules and number of sites

whyNoPrice.question: Why isn't there a price shown?
whyNoPrice.answer: The rate depends on the modules activated, the number of stations or vehicles tracked, and your organization's own setup. Rather than showing a figure that would not fit anyone, we put together a quote with you once we understand your business.

howQuoteWorks.question: How do I get a quote?
howQuoteWorks.answer: Tell us about your business through the free trial form or by contacting us directly. Our team gets back to you to understand your needs and propose a suitable setup.

canChangeLater.question: Can I change plans later?
canChangeLater.answer: Modules can be activated or deactivated as your organization evolves. The simplest way to adjust your scope is to discuss it with our team.

selfService.question: Can I sign up and pay online right away?
selfService.answer: Not yet. Zylo Office does not offer self-service sign-up or payment at this time: every organization is set up with the help of our team.

whichModules.question: Which modules exist today?
whichModules.answer: Zylo Liquid covers fuel station management (tanks, cash, pricing, network) and Zylo Tanker covers tanker truck fleet management. More modules may be added over time.

closing.title: Let's talk about your organization
closing.subtitle: Tell us about your business and we'll get back to you with a suitable setup and quote.
